detailed_rationale:
Mastek is a mid-cap, vertically-focused IT services and digital-transformation provider (est. 1982) with meaningful UK public-sector exposure alongside India/US/APAC business, offering application development, BI/data warehousing, testing, and legacy modernization. Revenue has grown steadily from ~₹813cr (Jun-2024 quarter) to ~₹985cr (Jun-2026 quarter), a roughly low-double-digit run-rate consistent with the reported 3-year CAGR of ~13% and 1-year growth of ~7%. ROE (~15.5%) and ROCE (~18-19%) are healthy for the sector, and debt has been declining (~₹438cr, down from ~₹583cr a year prior).
Quarterly profit has been somewhat lumpy — a Sep-2024 print of ₹129cr stands out against a ₹72-110cr range in surrounding quarters, which looks like it could include a one-off (forex gain, tax credit, or similar) rather than pure operating strength, though the available disclosure does not let me pin down the exact driver; I am flagging it as checked but inconclusive rather than building the thesis around it, since even excluding that quarter the underlying trend is a steady low-teens growth business.
The stock has been heavily de-rated — down ~29% over 12 months and ~37% over 24 months despite the steady underlying growth — leaving it at just ~13x trailing earnings, statistically one of the cheaper names in the IT services space (value score ~93 in this universe). This looks like sector-wide multiple compression (global IT services demand growth has slowed, and GenAI-driven productivity fears are compressing pricing/multiples across the sector) rather than a company-specific breakdown — Mastek's own operating metrics (revenue growth, margins, deleveraging) have not deteriorated in step with the stock price.
recommendation_rationale: Quant recommendation is Hold on both windows (final_score_3y ~47.2, final_score_1y ~48.6). My own read supports Hold: the statistical cheapness (~13x P/E) and steady underlying growth are genuine positives, but sector-wide GenAI/pricing-disruption risk to the IT-services model is real enough that I would not push this toward a stronger call without more clarity on how that risk plays out for a company Mastek's size.
summary: Mastek is a steady, mid-sized IT services company with UK public-sector exposure, growing revenue in the low double digits with healthy returns on capital and a deleveraging balance sheet. The stock has de-rated sharply along with the broader IT services sector on fears that AI-driven productivity gains will compress services pricing, leaving it statistically cheap at around 13x earnings despite no clear deterioration in its own operating performance. We rate this a Hold.
positive_para: Steady low-double-digit revenue growth over multiple years, healthy ROE (~15.5%) and ROCE (~18-19%), and a balance sheet that has been actively deleveraging. At ~13x trailing earnings, the stock is statistically one of the cheaper names in IT services, offering a reasonable margin of safety if sector sentiment stabilizes.
negative_para: The stock's sharp de-rating (-29% over 12 months) reflects a real, sector-wide concern: GenAI-driven productivity gains threaten to compress traditional IT-services pricing and billable-hour models over time, and a mid-cap player like Mastek has less scale to reinvent its offering than larger peers. One quarter's profit (Sep-2024) looks unusually elevated versus the surrounding range, a possible one-off that was not fully resolvable from available disclosure.
reverse_dcf_judgment: At ~13x trailing earnings against ~15.5% ROE and low-double-digit growth, the multiple already prices in meaningful structural risk to the IT-services model rather than crediting the company for its steady execution — a reasonably balanced, statistically cheap valuation rather than one flashing genuine distress.
